image_description: A side-profile view of a dark-furred wombat standing on reddish-brown soil with scattered green leaves. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body, short legs, and a broad, blunt head. The background consists of a textured rock face or wall.

The transition from the lower leg to the foot is slightly indistinct and 'mushy', lacking the sharp definition of individual toes or claws seen in high-quality photography, though plausible at this distance.
